subject.title: [Proposal] Simplify Model Configuration: Single-Source Reconcile + Session Override Reset

question: Should OpenClaw add official `models reconcile` and/or `sessions model-reset` commands, and what should those commands be allowed to change by default?
rationale: The choice affects persisted session state, explicit user model/auth selections, per-agent overrides, generated model catalog state, and provider routing, so source inspection cannot safely choose the compatibility semantics.

options.title: Dry-run plus opt-in reset
options.body: Add report-first reconcile/reset commands that preserve explicit pins by default and require scoped flags to clear session, agent, or auth-profile overrides.

options.title: Status and doctor only
options.body: Keep runtime precedence unchanged and improve diagnostics, warnings, and doctor/config validation for shadowed or invalid model refs.

options.title: Automatic reset precedence
options.body: Make default-model changes or resets clear existing pins automatically, accepting a compatibility break for durable session or agent selections.

recommendation.title: Dry-run plus opt-in reset
recommendation.body: Add report-first reconcile/reset commands that preserve explicit pins by default and require scoped flags to clear session, agent, or auth-profile overrides.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest observed history across model config, per-session model selection, shared session model helpers, and model command behavior.
